name: Fujian Foxit Software Development Joint Stock Co., Ltd.
summary: Fujian Foxit Software Development Joint Stock Co., Ltd. engages in the provision of PDF electronic document solutions worldwide. It offers PDF core technologies, such as document lifecycle, including document generation, conversion, display, editing, searching, printing, storage, signing, forms, protection, and secure distribution management. The company is also involved in general-purpose formatted documents, intelligent document processing platforms and applications, and digital government products and services.
